rektion: etw. (Akk.) bereuen; bereuen, etw. getan zu haben
definition_de: sich wünschen, etwas nicht getan zu haben, weil es falsch oder schlecht war
example_de: Kaum war die Familienpizza leer, bereute er schon, sie ganz allein gegessen zu haben.
example_en: The moment the family-size pizza was gone, he already regretted eating it all by himself.
user_example_de: Ich habe Angst, dass ich später alles bereue.
visual_idea: Collocation 'bereuen, etw. getan zu haben': a man slumped on the sofa holding his overfull stomach next to an empty family-size pizza box with only crumbs left. The deed is done and can't be undone (empty box), his face and pose show the regret, and the humor makes it memorable. A still image is enough: eating a whole pizza doesn't fit a 5-second video.
image_prompt: a man in his thirties slumped back on a sofa in a cozy living room, both hands on his overfull round stomach, the top button of his jeans open, eyes squeezed shut and mouth pulled into a pained, regretful grimace, on the coffee table in front of him a huge open family-size pizza box, completely empty except for a few crumbs and one crust, evening lamp light
negative_prompt: text, letters, watermark, signature, caption, blurry, extra fingers, deformed hands, cluttered background, multiple panels
video_prompt: a man slumped on a sofa next to an empty family-size pizza box groans, slowly rubs his overfull stomach, looks at the empty box and lets his head fall back against the sofa in regret; static medium shot
